text:
Type: solid pine shelf board
Use: extra shelf for an open shelving system, holding books, boxes and decor; living room, home office, storage room
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots, grey metal edge rails
Colors: light natural pine, warm pale yellow, grey-beige metal
Shape: flat rectangular plank with square edges, slim metal rails along the short sides for fitting between uprights, simple and light, compact
Feel: natural, honest, warm, practical
Goes with: raw wood, white walls, linen and woven baskets; Scandinavian, rustic or workshop-style rooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
